caption: The drawing features two wooden objects, resembling handles or knobs, depicted against a beige, slightly textured background with soft brown shading around the borders. Both objects are rendered in shades of brown, with visible wood grain and smooth gradients indicating rounded, three-dimensional forms. The larger object is positioned diagonally from the bottom left to the top center, featuring three carved grooves near its wider end and a central, recessed channel running much of its length. The smaller object is attached perpendicularly near the top right of the larger one, with a similarly grooved design at both ends and a narrower, bulbous center section. The objects cast faint shadows, enhancing their sense of depth. Below the objects, slightly to the right, the signature "ED J. GILSGLEIDER" is present, written in uppercase letters.
title: Watchman's Rattle
